# Acme CRM: deal workflow spec

This spec is the contract for the Deals page of Acme CRM. The app must do what it says.

Serve the app:
Open http://127.0.0.1:8766/ in your browser. The page shows the heading "Deals".

claims.objective: Open http://127.0.0.1:8766/ and check that the page shows the heading "Deals".

span.text: Type "Globex renewal" into the "Deal name" box, type "12000" into the "Amount" box and click "Add deal". The pipeline table shows "Globex renewal".

claims.objective: Type "Globex renewal" into the "Deal name" box, type "12000" into the "Amount" box and click "Add deal", then check that the pipeline table shows "Globex renewal".

span.text: On the "Globex renewal" row, click the "Mark as won" button. The deal's status changes to "Won".

claims.objective: On the "Globex renewal" row, click the "Mark as won" button and check that the deal's status reads "Won".
